授業科目の概要.科目名称: 学術英語・スキルベース
授業科目の概要.講義題目: Academic English: Skill-based - Test-taking, TOEIC Listening and Reading Test
授業科目の概要.使用言語: 英語及び日本語を併用（E/J）
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 夏学期 火曜日 ４時限
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: The course “Academic English: Skill-based – Test-taking, TOEIC Listening and Reading Test” is intended for university students who want to prepare for the TOEIC Listening and Reading Test by acquiring effective stratagems to boost their test score. The target score of the textbook selected for this course is 600 points or more. Each unit of the textbook is divided into a listening section and a reading section which can both be freely used. Types of questions discussed in listening section are: (1) statements about photographs; (2) question-response-type questions; (3) questions on conversations; (4) questions on talks; etc. Types of questions covered in the reading section are: (1) incomplete sentences; (2) text completion; (3) single passages; etc.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: この授業は、将来の学術研究に応用できる中級レベルの特定の発信スキルを発展させることを目的とする。この授業はスキルに焦点を当てた授業であり、学修目的に合わせて、ディベート、ディスカッション、オーラル・コミュニケーション、プレゼンテーション、ライティング、テスト・テイキングなど様々なスキルから授業を選択することができる。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This course is designed to develop students’ intermediate levels of specific productive skills that can be applied in their future academic research. This is a skill-based course that provides students with opportunities to choose a skill that suits their learning purposes from among diverse topics, including debate, discussion, oral communication, presentation, writing, test-taking, etc.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Test-taking; TOEIC Listening and Reading Test; listening skills; reading skills.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考: この授業は8週で１単位のクォータ科目です。単位認定には、最低45時間の学習時間のうち、１週あたり3.5時間程度の事前・事後学習を含みます。This is a quarter course which credits one unit for attending 8 lessons (weeks). To fulfill the credit requirement, students are expected to work a minimum of 45 hours. Homework may include approximately 3.5-hour pre-class assignments and post-class compre+E8hension activities.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.定期試験: None. There is no final examination.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.その他: Students need to bring the paper version of the above-mentioned textbook [テキスト] to every class meeting. If they do not bring the paper version of their textbook, they will not be able to complete in-class quizzes, which will negatively affect their grade.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: 注意: 生成AIは執筆の際に役立つツールとなりえます。しかし、生成AIはあくまで補助として使用し、代替ツールとして利用することは認められません。生成AIの言葉をコピーして自分が書いたふりをすることは、それが授業で直接許可されない限り、盗作（いわゆるカンニング）と見なされます。生成AIやその他類似のツールのコピーは、得点を失う原因となります。さらに深刻な場合、不合格となる可能性があります。授業によって、生成AIの使用時期や方法について他のルールを設定する場合があります。Notes: Generative AI can be a useful tool when writing. However, generative AI should only be used to help you, never to do work for you. Copying words from generative AI and pretending that you wrote them is considered to be plagiarism (a kind of cheating) unless your instructor directly says it is allowed. Copying from generative AI or any other place will cause you to lose points. If the problem is serious enough, you may fail the class. Your instructor may set other rules about when and how generative AI can be used.
